title: Ask-versus-got error by training epoch
words: Error falls early, then flattens by epoch 34. Recorded checkpoints from one training run. The same sampling seed is used at every epoch. Lower error means achieved win rates are closer to requests. 0.000 0.005 0.010 0.015 0.020 0.025 0.030 1 21 34 55 80 Ask-versus-got error Training epoch Near line < 0.001 Score covers requests from 1/24 to 17/24. Dots are measured checkpoints; connecting lines guide the eye. Thin bars show 95% intervals from resampling whole teams and shared opponent columns. They exclude variation between training runs. The dashed reference is the near-line threshold, error under 0.001. Inspect a checkpoint Change the epoch to see where achieved win rates still miss the requests. The epoch 1 curve stays visible for comparison. Error 0.0059 Upper-request error 0.1344 Root mean squared gap 7.7 pp Epoch 34 Epoch 1 Got = ask 0% 0% 25% 25% 50% 50% 75% 75% 100% 100% Achieved win rate Requested win rate Dashed curve segment and shaded band cover requests 18/24 to 23/24, where training examples are scarce. Those requests are scored separately. All checkpoints, diversity and scoring details Epoch Error 1/24–17/24 Error 18/24–23/24 Distinct line-ups New line-ups Full 66 points Team spread pp Epoch 1 0.0175 0.2831 427 262 24.5% 9.8 Epoch 2 0.0131 0.2401 462 290 25.0% 9.6 Epoch 3 0.0117 0.2281 436 268 26.3% 9.6 Epoch 5 0.0095 0.2020 470 281 27.8% 9.5 Epoch 8 0.0085 0.1931 459 269 29.2% 9.6 Epoch 13 0.0077 0.1645 462 254 28.1% 9.4 Epoch 21 0.0069 0.1525 448 244 27.5% 9.0 Epoch 34 0.0059 0.1344 466 258 27.3% 9.4 Epoch 55 0.0061 0.1350 483 266 27.6% 9.2 Epoch 80 0.0060 0.1406 493 263 26.9% 9.6 A line-up is a team's six species, independent of slot order. Counts are unique line-ups across all 1,472 generated teams. New line-ups are absent from the fixed reference described below. Full 66 points is the share of Pokémon spending all available Stat Points. Team spread is the average within-request standard deviation of team win rates, in percentage points. New line-up reference: 54,766 distinct six-species line-ups from 170,785 labelled non-validation rows, fixed before rule-table filtering. Five rows were excluded from actual training. Novelty here is relative to that larger reference. Uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap; whole teams within each ask and shared opponent columns across epochs; original opponent weights retained Every checkpoint uses training seed 0 and sampling seed 1, with 64 teams at each of 23 requests. Each team plays the 49 distinct top-50 opponents under the behaviour-cloning policy on both sides, with shuffled slots. The opponent represented twice in the top-50 list has weight 2 in the win-rate mean. The model generates all 84 fields. Stat Alignment is repaired to match the moves. Teams come from the labelled-only model trained with label noise ±1/48; these are checkpoint samples without a search or elite-selection rule. Existing three-sampling-seed summaries are kept separate: epoch 21, error 0.0066; epoch 80, error 0.0053. They are not substituted into the one-seed epoch curve. Sampling-repeatability is a separate decision ticket. This exploratory comparison comes from one training run. Sampling and opponent resampling do not measure variation between independent training runs. Epoch 80 is the training cap and the lowest validation-loss checkpoint; these observations do not establish the best epoch beyond that cap. All 14,720 seed-1 teams have 49/49 opponent coverage and exactly 49 battles. Weighted matrix scores reproduce every saved score. The original checkpoint files matched all ten recorded hashes. Epoch-80 preflight passed, including its 20-team round trip. The battle database records showdown:unknown for the simulator revision.
